title: FontVariant
description: CSS font-variant-caps values the glyph rasterizer honours. `'small-caps'` renders lowercase letters as reduced capitals - from the family's own small-cap glyphs where it has them, otherwise from the browser's synthesis. The variant is part of a glyph atlas's identity, so small-cap glyphs never share cache entries with the ordinary ones.

sections.title: Import
paragraphs: CSS font-variant-caps values the glyph rasterizer honours.

`'small-caps'` renders lowercase letters as reduced capitals - from the family's own small-cap glyphs where it has them, otherwise from the browser's synthesis. The variant is part of a glyph atlas's identity, so small-cap glyphs never share cache entries with the ordinary ones.
